chapters.title: 1. Intro to Flexbox
chapters.content:
The Flexible Box Layout Module makes it easier to design flexible responsive layout structures without using floats.

The Flex Container

.flex-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}
Pro Tip: Flex Direction
By default, flex items are laid out horizontally. Use flex-direction: column to stack items vertically.

chapters.title: 2. CSS Grid Architecture
chapters.content:
CSS Grid Layout excels at dividing a page into major regions, or defining the relationship in terms of size, position, and layer.

Defining a Grid

.grid-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

This creates a 3-column grid where each column takes up an equal fraction (1fr) of the available space, with a 20px gap between items.

chapters.title: 3. Responsive Design
chapters.content:
Responsive web design makes your web page look good on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).

Media Queries

Media queries allow you to apply CSS properties only when a specific condition is true.

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .grid-container {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
Mobile-First Approach
It is often best practice to write your base CSS for mobile devices first, and then use min-width media queries to add styles for larger screens.

chapters.title: 4. Animations & Keyframes
chapters.content:
CSS animations make it possible to animate transitions from one CSS style configuration to another.

@keyframes Rule

@keyframes slideIn {
  from {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

.box {
  animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

chapters.title: 5. Variables & Theming
chapters.content:
CSS Variables (Custom Properties) allow you to store specific values for reuse throughout your stylesheet.

Declaring Variables

:root {
  --primary-color: #04AA6D;
  --text-color: #333333;
}

body {
  color: var(--text-color);
}

.btn {
  background-color: var(--primary-color);
}

This is extremely useful for maintaining consistent spacing, typography scales, and creating dark/light themes!
